Abstract excerpt: Multimodal clinical AI is limited by weakly aligned inputs and the absence of domain-specific interpretable representations, particularly when learning from dense video stream, structured time-series, and template-based kinematic text. Here we present ScoliDetect, an explainable framework for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis screening from monocular gait video, built around a kinematic knowledge map (KKM) and complementary template-based kinematic text derived from per-sequence pose statics.
